comment: Consensus-owned roster anchors: locked-in starters and universally drafted
players who are never legitimate standard 12-team waiver claims.
Two consumers read this list, which is why it lives in its own file rather
than inline in either of them:
- scripts/build-blog.mjs fails the build if a Waiver Wire article lists
one of these players as a claim.
- scripts/generate-editorial.mjs leaves them off a generated waiver board
before the build ever sees the file, because Sleeper's platform-wide
add counts include the drop/add churn around big names.
A copy in each file would drift, and the drift would only surface as a
failed build on an article that was already written.
Matched case-insensitively against the normalized full name. Extend as the
consensus baseline shifts week to week.
